svg.title: Map Outposts, stepping stone
svg.desc: A solid dot for home, a smaller dot halfway, and an open ring beyond it: the outpost with the trip out to it drawn as one step. Drawn in one ink on the budget-drs app icon's box and rules, for the page to paint in its text colour: solid, no strokes, and every gap at least 2.5 units, which is about 1.4 CSS pixels at 16.
